meta.note: MoSPI's compendium reprints this table from National Family Health Survey, NFHS-4 (2015-16) and NFHS-5 (2019-21), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (IIPS); the figures are that agency's. This bundle holds one instrument only (NFHS-4, 2015-16); the indicator's other instrument is a separate bundle, never joined to this one. Values printed as "-" (no observation) or "NR" (not reported) are not baked; meta.omitted counts them.
